an9.2:1.1: aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an9.2:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu nissayasampanno hotīti.
an9.2:1.4: saddhañce bhikkhu nissāya akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti pahīnamevassa taṃ akusalaṃ hoti
an9.2:1.8: paññañce bhikkhu nissāya akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti pahīnamevassa taṃ akusalaṃ hoti
an9.2:1.9: tañhissa bhikkhuno akusalaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti suppahīnaṃ yassa ariyāya paññāya disvā pahīnaṃ
an9.2:2.1: tena ca pana bhikkhave bhikkhunā imesu pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cattāro upanissayā viharitabbā
an9.2:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saṅkhāyekaṃ paṭisevati saṅkhāyekaṃ adhivāseti saṅkhāyekaṃ parivajjeti saṅkhāyekaṃ vinodeti
an9.2:2.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu nissayasampanno hotīti. 3
